text:
anna: Morning standup — quick sync: what I did / blockers / today
what I did: rolled canary config for auth-jwt-rotation to 15% on gateway
blocker: seeing intermittent 429s from /v1/stream when burst >100rps, not sure if routing or quota
today: dig into rate-policy windows, pair with @mike on logs, open PR for fallback route

mike: On it. Can you paste the timeframe and sample request IDs? I'll check gateway/nginx logs. Also ping @jordan for routing policy history. :eyes:

anna: Sample request ids: req_48f3a2, req_48f3b7. Occurred ~08:14–08:20 UTC. 429 response body shows "rate_limited" header but X-Region was "us-west-2"

jordan: FYI I adjusted the policy last week — lowered burst for anonymous endpoints. Could be interaction with prefix-based caching. I'll pull the policy diff. @sara did we enable the new batching window?

sara: Yes, batching window default is 20ms in staging, 15ms in prod. I can try temporarily increasing to 25ms for low-priority endpoints. Also can run a synthetic rps test.

leo: Also noticed that the auth service returned 503 for a short spike at 08:18 — might cascade. I can repro locally with a short script. Putting up PR #3178 for health-check backoff.

anna: Thanks — I'll coordinate: @mike + @leo can you join for a 15-min pairing at 09:30 UTC? Also posting the minimal policy snippet that governs /v1/stream:

```yaml
routes:
  - path: /v1/stream
    rate_limit:
      requests_per_minute: 6000
      burst: 120
    priority: high
    fallback: /v1/stream-lite
```

mike: Looks fine but burst=120 might be too low for multiplexed streams. Try bumping to 300 for canary and monitor. Also check token bucket refills.

anna: Will try bump to 300 in canary, then rollback if errors. Also filing short alert: #alerts -> 'gateway:High429Stream' with threshold 1% over 5m. @deploy-bot initiating canary change. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Started canary update for gateway config canary_id=canary-20260301-13, set /v1/stream burst=300 for 15% traffic.

jordan: If 503 persists, switch fallback to fallback path and enable cache bypass for auth headers. Also leaving a CR comment on PR 3124 about metrics.

sara: :thumbsup: If we need, I can temporarily raise batching window and run load test. No blockers from infra side.

anna: Great. Blockers cleared for now. Today's focus: monitor canary, adjust rate-policy, pair with @mike at 09:30. If anything urgent drop into #eng-oncall.
